plan.goal: De novo design one small soluble protein candidate, evaluate sequence and structure evidence, perform basic QC, and rank.
assumptions: Unconditional backbone generation is sufficient for a compact soluble protein without a specific binding target.
A length range of 60–80 residues is appropriate for a small soluble protein.
One backbone and one designed sequence per backbone is sufficient for a compact single-candidate workflow.
ESM3 sequence-to-structure provides adequate folding and confidence scoring without a dedicated folding server.
Sequence analysis and protein_qc together cover sufficient quality indicators for pre-ranking triage.
